description: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layer configurations and token/precision settings. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale, ranging from Layer1-4 to Layer29-32, with tick labels at each layer configuration. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and has a linear scale, ranging from -20% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. A gray dashed line represents the “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” and remains approximately constant at 0% relative change across the x-axis, starting at 0% at Layer1-4 and ending at approximately 0% at Layer29-32. A yellow line with circular markers represents “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”, beginning at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, decreasing to approximately -7% at Layer13-20, and then increasing to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. An orange line with square markers represents “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”, starting at approximately -1% at Layer1-4, decreasing to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, and then increasing to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. A light blue line with circular markers represents “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”, beginning at approximately -5% at Layer1-4, decreasing to approximately -18% at Layer13-20, and then increasing to approximately -7% at Layer29-32. A dark blue line with square markers represents “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”, starting at approximately -5% at Layer1-4, decreasing to approximately -12% at Layer13-20, and then increasing to approximately -5% at Layer29-32.
